target_customer: Home services companies (HVAC, plumbing, electrical) using ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro or Jobber; the company site separately markets a paid ads agency to Shopify brands
problem: Home services companies lose leads on missed calls and run half-booked schedules because dispatch is manual. AI agents answer calls, route jobs to technicians and keep the calendar full.
business_model: B2B SaaS for AI call and dispatch agents; the company website also sells paid ads agency services
product_category: AI voice agents and dispatch for field services

founders.name: Kyle Chang
previous_startups: AI facility management platform reported at $600K ARR with customers named on the YC page (outcome not stated)

founders.name: Kevin Wong
prior_employers: Unnamed venture-backed startup (founding engineer, agentic infrastructure)
education: UC Berkeley, Industrial Engineering and Operations Research

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice agents plus integrations with three field service systems and dispatch logic are standard engineering with hard parts in reliability and latency, made easier by 2026 voice model APIs.

defensibility.rationale: Many funded voice agent rivals and the platforms' own built-in agents make copying easy; integrations are the only lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The three platforms it integrates with already shipped their own AI receptionists by 2026, so the wedge was already contested at founding.

market_need_then: Missed calls cost home services businesses jobs, and 2026 guides list many AI receptionist products, which shows demand and also crowding.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, results focused, taglines such as 'Ads that sell. Spend that pays off.' on the agency site

brand_strength.rationale: Name is confusable with Central (a funded back-office startup) and CentraCom; site markets a different offering from the YC page.

outcome_analysis: CentralComs is an active Spring 2026 company. The founders built an earlier AI facility management product and the company site now advertises a Shopify paid ads agency, which differs from the YC page's home services AI agents. The AI receptionist space is crowded and the integrated platforms ship their own agents. No exit or shutdown was found.
notes: Company website banner states a seed round at a $30M valuation led by Y Combinator, with no amount or date; the date is recorded as 2026 only as the batch year and the round is not otherwise corroborated. Caplight lists $500,000 total, unverified. Other sources describe a property management product, unverified. Websearch for outcomes returned only unrelated companies. Competitor sources are 2026 vendor and affiliate guides without launch dates.
